permitted_actions: Create one fresh-context I1 reviewer using fork_turns=none; read the frozen C1J evidence and source candidate only; return an independent written assessment in the reviewer response.

Create one separate fresh-context Final Critic using fork_turns=none; do not share I1's report or findings before the Final Critic response; read the same frozen C1J evidence and source candidate only; return an independent written assessment.
The lead may persist both reviewer responses and attempt metadata only under docs/04_audit/evidence/AUD-20260924/M07-S1-C1K/.
post_attempt_governance_records: current navigation pointers only, if their next-action text changes
governance_record_limit: After an approved review attempt, the lead may update these CVG records only to record the decision, attempt result, unchanged gate scope, current blockers, and next action. Such updates cannot authorize new reviews, code, checks, downstream stages, or production. Reviewers may not write these records.
forbidden_actions: Edit, stage, or revert product, configuration, test, manifest, policy, or historical evidence files.
Run tests, builds, typechecks, lint, coverage, scanners, candidate freeze, or any command from C1J or another gate.
Use real data, external services, databases, external network, sensitive actions, or production.
Treat a missing reviewer, unavailable reviewer, silence, lead assessment, or one review as satisfying the other review.
Change C1J's recorded FAIL / OPEN verdict or declare M07-S1 accepted as a side effect of C1K.
stop_conditions: If either reviewer cannot be created, stop that role and record UNAVAILABLE; do not retry under C1K.
If candidate or evidence source integrity is questioned, stop and record the concern without running verification commands.
Any material finding or unavailable review keeps M07-S1 FAIL / OPEN and requires a new scoped decision before further work.
